event_headline: Pastor Mark Burns dedicates 22-foot gold statue of Donald Trump

chronology.action: Dedicated a 22-foot gold statue of Donald Trump
Asserted Trump understands the Bible better than Pope Leo and credited Trump for preventing Iran from acquiring a weapon that would destroy Israel and the Middle East
Read from Chronicles 2 at a day-long prayer rally in DC: 'If my people shall HUMBLE themselves & pray, then will I hear from heaven & forgive their sin'
Shared video of Nigerian pastor standing in mass grave begging for help, stating 'They are KILLING Christians in Nigeria'
Spoke to thousands about 'genocide of Christians in Africa,' stating 'We will NOT remain silent while our Christian brothers and sisters are being raped and pillaged in any country in the world'

Quoted Isaiah 6:8 at West Point graduation: 'Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, Whom shall I send? And who will go for us? And I said, Here I am. Send me!' Declared 'America is a Christian nation'
Gathered at Israeli Knesset during Jerusalem Prayer Breakfast to offer prayers of repentance for their nations' failure to support Israel and confront anti-Semitism
Stopped to pray after 2-0 victory over Australia in the World Cup
Posted statement: 'America has always been, and always will be, ONE NATION UNDER GOD'
Made Bible stories required reading in schools

verified_facts.claim: Pastor Mark Burns dedicated a 22-foot gold statue of Donald Trump
verified_facts.finding: Multiple sources confirm that Pastor Mark Burns dedicated a 22-foot gold statue of Donald Trump at Trump National Doral Miami in Florida. The dedication ceremony occurred in January 2025, with Burns describing the statue as standing as a reminder of God's protection over Trump.

verified_facts.claim: Iran was 'WEEKS from weapon that would destroy Israel & Middle East' before Trump prevented it
verified_facts.finding: The search results do not contain any information about Iran being 'weeks from a weapon that would destroy Israel & Middle East' or Trump preventing such a scenario. The results discuss 2026 events including sanctions, Netanyahu pushing Trump for military action against Iran, and ceasefire agreements, but make no mention of Iran's proximity to developing a devastating weapon or Trump stopping it.

verified_facts.claim: Christians are being killed in Nigeria
verified_facts.finding: The claim that Christians are being killed in Nigeria is factually supported by multiple sources documenting thousands of Christian deaths. However, the framing is contested - some sources note that while Christians face significant violence, other groups (particularly Muslims) are also victims of violence in Nigeria, and the scale and nature of targeting is disputed among monitoring organizations.

verified_facts.claim: Texas made Bible stories required reading in schools
verified_facts.finding: The claim is confirmed by multiple credible news sources. The Texas State Board of Education approved a mandatory reading list for public schools that includes Bible stories, with the decision occurring on June 26, 2026. Multiple outlets including USA Today, Associated Press, and PBS reported this as a requirement for Texas public school students.

verified_facts.claim: Christian representatives from several countries prayed at Israeli Knesset for their nations' failure to support Israel
verified_facts.finding: Multiple sources confirm that Christian representatives from several countries (reported as 38 nations) gathered at the Israeli Knesset during the Jerusalem Prayer Breakfast and offered prayers of repentance for their nations' failure to support Israel. The event is consistently reported across Al Jazeera, Eastern Herald, and World Times Daily.

disputed_claims.claim: The 22-foot gold statue dedication violates the commandment 'Thou shalt not worship false idols'
disputed_claims.competing_accounts: ProudSocialist frames it as religious manipulation for political idolatry; no counter-frame visible in source material

disputed_claims.claim: Trump understands the Bible better than Pope Leo

Hegseth and White House assert this explicitly; no competing frame documented in source material
